q: The list of approved suppliers _____ updated every quarter.
why: The subject is “list,” which is singular. The phrase “of approved suppliers” does not change the subject.

q: By the time the conference begins, the technical team _____ the presentation equipment.
why: Use the future perfect for an action that will be completed before a specified future time.

q: If the shipment _____ before noon, the warehouse can process it today.
why: In a first conditional, use the present simple in the if-clause and a present or future result clause.

q: All travel expenses must be submitted _____ the end of the month.
why: “By” sets a deadline: the expenses must be submitted no later than the end of the month.

q: The updated ordering system should _____ the time required to process large shipments.
why: After the modal verb “should,” use the base form of the verb. “Reduce” is the verb form needed here.

q: The assistant _____ organized the documents before the audit.
why: The word modifies the verb “organized,” so an adverb is required.

q: The board requested a detailed _____ of the proposed investment.
why: The article “a” and adjective “detailed” signal that a singular count noun is needed.

q: The company will _____ the launch until the safety inspection is complete.
why: “Postpone” means to delay an event until a later time, which fits the safety condition.

q: Applicants must provide _____ documentation to verify their professional experience.
why: “Relevant” means directly connected with the matter being considered.

q: The first proposal exceeded the budget; _____, the committee approved the revised version.
why: “However” introduces a contrast between the budget problem and the later approval.

q: The marketing department _____ its annual report at next week's meeting.
why: “At next week's meeting” refers to a future event, so the future form is appropriate.

q: Neither the regional director nor the branch managers _____ available this afternoon.
why: With “neither…nor,” the verb agrees with the nearer subject. “Branch managers” is plural.

q: If the company had renewed the contract earlier, it _____ the discount.
why: This is a third conditional: an unreal past condition takes “would have” plus the past participle.

q: The revised policy will take effect _____ January 1.
why: Use “on” with a specific calendar date.

q: The unexpected _____ of the flight caused several passengers to miss their connections.
why: The sentence needs a noun as its subject. “Cancellation” is the noun form of “cancel.”

q: Company policy documents are _____ through the employee portal at any time.
why: The sentence describes the availability of the documents, so it needs the adjective “accessible.”

q: The supplier responded _____ to the urgent request.
why: The blank modifies the verb “responded,” so an adverb is required. “Promptly” means without delay.

q: The finance team will _____ the funds among the three departments.
why: “Allocate” means to distribute resources for a particular purpose.

q: The warranty is valid only if the product is used in _____ with the instructions.
why: The fixed expression is “in accordance with,” meaning in agreement with or following.

q: The office will be closed for maintenance; _____, employees should work remotely.
why: “Therefore” introduces the logical result of the office closure.

q: The agreement will remain in effect unless either party _____ written notice at least 30 days in advance.
why: In a future condition introduced by “unless,” use the present simple in the clause, not “will.”

q: Each of the applications _____ reviewed by two members of the admissions team.
why: “Each” is singular and takes a singular verb, even when followed by a plural noun in an of-phrase.

q: The consultant is responsible _____ preparing the monthly performance report.
why: The adjective “responsible” is followed by the preposition “for” before a noun or gerund.

q: The company is seeking a _____ solution to reduce its operating costs.
why: The blank describes the noun “solution,” so an adjective is required.

q: The revised policy will _____ the approval process for routine purchases.
why: After the modal verb “will,” use the base form of the verb. “Simplify” is the verb form that fits the sentence.

q: The revised figures were _____ checked before the report was published.
why: The blank modifies the passive verb phrase “were checked,” so an adverb is needed.

q: The hotel offers a _____ shuttle service between the airport and the city center.
The director asked staff to _____ the original receipts for reimbursement.
why: “Retain” means to keep something rather than discard it.

q: The auditor identified several _____ between the purchase orders and the amounts billed.
why: “Discrepancies” are differences or inconsistencies between two sets of information, which fits the auditor's findings.

q: _____ the unexpected delay, the team completed the installation before the deadline.
why: “Despite” is followed by a noun phrase and introduces a contrast or concession.

q: The revised safety policy _____ by all department heads before it takes effect.
why: The policy receives the action: modal + be + past participle.

q: Ms. Chen _____ with the supplier since early Monday.
why: Since indicates an activity continuing to the present.

q: Each of the invoices _____ a purchase order number.
If the printer continues to malfunction, the technician _____ it tomorrow.
The presentation, which _____ by the marketing team, received positive feedback.
Employees are encouraged _____ their suggestions through the online portal.
The finance director requested a _____ breakdown of the annual expenses.
why: The blank describes the noun breakdown.

q: The new software improves the _____ of monthly reports.
Please handle customer records _____ to protect private information.
The _____ of the contract requires another legal review.
why: The subject position requires a noun.

q: Warehouse staff must _____ the incoming packages before storage.
why: Use the base verb after must.

q: After reviewing her qualifications, the committee confirmed that the candidate was _____ for the position.
To reach customers in new markets, the company plans to _____ its product line.
Because the repair required several specialized parts, the final cost was more _____ than expected.
The training room is _____ from the main lobby, so visitors can find it easily.
The automated payment system will _____ the need for employees to enter each transaction manually.
_____ the budget was limited, the project team completed the renovation on schedule.
The report includes last quarter's sales figures. _____, it contains a forecast for the coming year.
Please submit the application by Friday _____ the committee can review it next week.
The order was delayed _____ the warehouse closed earlier than expected.
When the auditors arrived, the accounting team _____ the requested files.
why: The action happened before another past event.

q: The consultant _____ prepared the market analysis will present it on Tuesday.
why: Who refers to a person as subject.

q: Visitors _____ wear identification badges while inside the research facility.
The updated delivery system is _____ than the previous version.
By next June, the company _____ its new distribution center.
why: By next June sets a future completion point.

q: The supervisor recommended _____ the equipment before the morning shift begins.
The manager praised the staff for their _____ response to the unexpected request.
The new employee explained the procedure _____ so that everyone could follow it.
The board asked for a written _____ of the proposed merger.
The technician will _____ the damaged cables before restarting the server.
why: Use the base verb after will.

q: The instructions must be _____ enough for first-time users to understand.
The company issued a _____ statement explaining why the product release had been delayed.
The purchasing department will _____ three proposals before selecting a supplier.
The hotel offers a complimentary shuttle, meaning transportation is provided _____ to guests.
The revised schedule is _____ with the department's staffing requirements.
why: Compatible means able to work together.

q: The supplier agreed to _____ the full amount after the duplicate payment was identified.
The delivery can be released _____ the customer provides the correct authorization code.
The first shipment arrived two days early; _____, the installation team began work ahead of schedule.
The receptionist will contact the visitors _____ their appointments have been confirmed.
The office is small, _____ it has enough space for the entire support team.
Neither the director nor the assistants _____ available to answer questions this afternoon.
why: The verb agrees with the nearer plural subject.

q: If the technician had received the updated instructions, she _____ the error earlier.
why: Third conditional: would have + past participle.

q: At 10:00 yesterday morning, the legal team _____ the final contract.
why: The action was in progress at a past time.

q: The shipment is not here yet; the carrier _____ the wrong address.
why: May have expresses a possible past event.

q: The company decided _____ its customer service hours during the holiday season.
Only _____ applicants had the technical experience required for the position.
why: Applicants is a plural count noun.

q: The annual conference attracted a large number of international _____.
why: A large number of requires a plural noun.

q: The warehouse manager checked the inventory _____ before submitting the report.
The company is looking for a more _____ method of tracking deliveries.
The legal department requested further _____ before approving the agreement.
why: Further is followed by a noun.

q: All visitors must _____ at the security desk before entering the building.
why: Use the base verb after must.

q: The director asked the team to _____ the key findings in a short executive summary.
why: Summarize means present main points briefly.

q: The maintenance work will take place during a _____ closure of the north entrance.
why: Temporary means lasting for a limited period.

q: The supplier's proposal was rejected because its delivery terms were not _____.
The receptionist gave the guests a _____ copy of the updated schedule so they could keep it.
why: A printed copy is a paper document.

q: _____ the software is expensive, it is expected to reduce operating costs over time.
The technician will test the system; _____, the supervisor will approve it for use.
Please contact the service desk _____ the online support form if you need assistance.
The presentation was rescheduled _____ the keynote speaker's flight was canceled.
The purchasing manager _____ the new supplier's references before signing the agreement.
why: The checking preceded another past action.

q: The quality of the submitted samples _____ a major factor in the laboratory's final assessment.
why: The head subject quality is singular.

q: The branch _____ opened last month has already exceeded its sales target.
The accounting department _____ the annual budget report, so it is ready for review.
why: Present perfect links a completed action to now.

q: All conference materials _____ to registered participants by the end of the day.
Unless the client _____ the revised quotation, the order cannot be processed.
why: Unless takes present simple for a future condition.

q: Employees _____ disclose confidential information to unauthorized individuals.
The train had already departed by the time we _____ at the station.
why: The later event uses simple past.

q: The revised application is considerably _____ to use than the previous version.
The committee postponed _____ a final decision until the next meeting.
The director will announce the results after the review committee _____ its evaluation.
why: Future time clauses use present simple.

q: The company introduced a _____ procedure for processing expense claims.
The _____ of the new branch is scheduled for early September.
why: Opening is the noun naming the event.

q: The assistant responded _____ to the customer's request for additional information.
The supervisor asked the clerk to _____ the figures before sending the invoice.
why: Use the base verb after to.

q: The unexpected _____ in fuel prices affected the delivery budget.
The new office layout is designed to be more _____ for employees with mobility needs.
The legal adviser examined the agreement _____ before giving approval.
The regional manager expressed _____ with the quality of the revised report.
The company will _____ its research budget to support the development of safer materials.
The director requested a _____ estimate rather than an exact figure at this early stage.
The office's new filing system allows staff to _____ older records without deleting them.
Because the replacement parts are no longer manufactured, the supply is extremely _____.
The company hired an _____ consultant who has no financial connection to either bidder.
The supervisor asked staff to _____ their access cards when leaving the building permanently.
The regional director _____ the final figures before the quarterly report was published.
why: The review preceded a past publication.

q: The supplier offered a lower price; _____, the delivery time was considerably longer.
The meeting was moved to the larger room _____ all department representatives could attend.
The company extended the application deadline _____ several candidates had experienced technical problems.
The warranty remains valid _____ the equipment is serviced by an authorized technician.
The new branch offers extended opening hours. _____, it provides free parking for customers.
